# Sosa Tech Solutions

> Bilingual English/Spanish technology and marketing partner for small businesses in Miami, founded by Victor Sosa. Based in Miami-Dade, Florida.
> Contact: WhatsApp +1 305-741-5702 (https://wa.me/13057415702) or email info@sosatechsolutions.com. Website: https://sosatechsolutions.com/

Sosa Tech Solutions builds websites, WhatsApp and follow-up automation, social media content, Facebook and Instagram ads, AI agents, AI spokesperson videos, streaming and the infrastructure behind them. Clients work directly with Victor, in English or Spanish, from the first conversation through implementation and support. Every page has an English (default) and Spanish version through the site's language toggle. En español: socio de tecnología y marketing bilingüe para pequeños negocios en Miami.

## Services

- [Websites](https://sosatechsolutions.com/services/websites/): Bilingual, mobile-first websites and landing pages built around the offer, with WhatsApp and contact forms that make the business easy to reach.
- [WhatsApp & follow-up automation](https://sosatechsolutions.com/services/automation/): Forms, WhatsApp, alerts and reminders connected so every inquiry reaches the right person with a clear next step.
- [Content creation & publishing](https://sosatechsolutions.com/services/content-engine/): Posts, carousels, Reels and AI-assisted visuals built around the brand, approved by the owner before scheduled Facebook and Instagram publishing.
- [Facebook & Instagram ads](https://sosatechsolutions.com/services/marketing/): Campaigns tied to a clear offer, a landing page or WhatsApp and a follow-up plan, with tracking that shows where inquiries come from. Ad spend is separate from service fees.
- [AI agents & integrations](https://sosatechsolutions.com/services/agents/): Custom AI assistants and integrations connected to approved business information and tools, with human review.
- [AI spokesperson videos](https://sosatechsolutions.com/services/ai-spokesperson/): Weekly short videos where a realistic AI presenter, always labeled as AI, explains the business's services in English or Spanish. The owner approves every script; scheduled Facebook and Instagram publishing is optional. Much cheaper than a film crew. The page shows three example Reels.
- [Streaming & broadcasting](https://sosatechsolutions.com/services/streaming/): Internet radio, website players and live audio or video streams, with monitoring and practical technical support.
- [Infrastructure & reliability](https://sosatechsolutions.com/services/infrastructure/): Server management, monitoring, encrypted backups and tested recovery for the systems behind a small business.

## Client work

- [Client work](https://sosatechsolutions.com/work/): Websites and systems Victor built for Miami businesses and online radio stations, with testimonials the clients approved. For several of these clients he also runs the content, WhatsApp campaigns or streaming. Every site below is live.
- [Mocasa Hair Transplant](https://mocasahairtransplant.com/) (hair restoration, Miami): landing page for hair and beard transplant consultations with a consultation form, WhatsApp and call links; plus social content and campaigns.
- [Mocasa Wellness Center](https://mocasawc.com/) (med spa, Miami): website with services, online booking and payment-plan information.
- [H.E.H. Consulting](https://hehconsultingfirm.com/) (government relations and public affairs, Miami): website with a Miami policy and business news section; plus Facebook and Instagram content and scheduled publishing, including Reels.
- [Miami Travel y Más](https://miamitravelymas.com/) (travel agency, Hialeah): Spanish-language website with WhatsApp contact and travel features; plus weekly travel flyers and posts.
- [Cafe Travel](https://cafetravel.com/) (travel agency and group tours, Miami): website; plus tour campaign flyers, videos and scheduled WhatsApp Status campaigns.
- [Radio To Be](https://radiotobemiami.com/) (online radio, Miami): website with a live player connected to the station stream, news headlines and app links; plus streaming setup and support.
- [Radio 305](https://radio305.com/) (online radio, "Tan Latina como Tú"): website with news and a live player that shows the song now playing; plus station audio imaging and streaming support.
- [Antena Florida](https://antenaflorida.com/) (online radio and news): website with a live player and headlines; plus the news publishing workflow.
- [Hispanic American Artist Group](https://haagkids.org/) (HAAG Foundation, Miami nonprofit bringing art and music to children with autism): bilingual English/Spanish website.
